level_description: Real-World Schemas (Adapted from production JSON Schemas and documented API/platform constraints -- GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, AWS Auto Scaling, Stripe, GeoJSON/RFC 7946, and carrier shipping-rate rules -- rather than synthetic benchmark authoring. Each field's bounds and cross-field relationships are sourced from real, citable documentation, not invented for this project.)

SS_ci_job_config.name: CI Job Configuration (GitHub Actions)
SS_ci_job_config.description: Adapted from GitHub's public workflow JSON Schema (github-workflow.json on SchemaStore) and GitHub Actions documentation: runs-on/permissions enums, and documented platform limits for timeout-minutes (360 min hard cap on GitHub-hosted runners) and a matrix strategy's max-parallel (GitHub caps a matrix at 256 generated jobs).

prompts.system: You are a CI/CD platform generating a validated GitHub Actions job configuration. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Generate a job configuration for a GitHub-hosted runner within GitHub's documented platform limits.

timeout_minutes.description: Job timeout (GitHub-hosted hard cap is 360 minutes)

max_parallel.description: strategy.max-parallel (GitHub caps a matrix at 256 jobs)

SS_k8s_container_resources.name: Kubernetes Container Resource Limits
SS_k8s_container_resources.description: Adapted from Kubernetes' documented resource-management rules (kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers): a container's resource limit must be at least its resource request, for both CPU (millicores) and memory (Mi) -- enforced by the kubelet/API server in real clusters, and structurally inexpressible in a context-free JSON Schema grammar.

prompts.system: You are a Kubernetes admission controller generating a validated container resource specification. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Generate CPU and memory requests/limits for a container. Limits must never be lower than the corresponding request.

cpu_limit_millicores.description: CPU limit in millicores (must be >= request)

memory_limit_mi.description: Memory limit in Mi (must be >= request)

SS_aws_autoscaling_group.name: AWS Auto Scaling Group Capacity
SS_aws_autoscaling_group.description: Adapted from AWS's documented Auto Scaling Group validation rule (CreateAutoScalingGroup/UpdateAutoScalingGroup API reference): DesiredCapacity must be >= MinSize and <= MaxSize. This three-way relational constraint across independently-generated fields is exactly the class of rule a context-free grammar cannot express.

prompts.system: You are the AWS Auto Scaling control plane generating a validated Auto Scaling Group capacity configuration. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Generate a capacity configuration for an Auto Scaling Group. DesiredCapacity must always be between MinSize and MaxSize inclusive.

desired_capacity.description: Desired capacity (must be between min_size and max_size)

SS_stripe_invoice.name: Payment Invoice (Stripe Invoice object)
SS_stripe_invoice.description: Adapted from Stripe's public Invoice API object (docs.stripe.com/api/invoices): subtotal, tax, total, amount_paid, amount_remaining, and status are real field names from Stripe's documented schema. Models the real relations total = subtotal + tax and amount_remaining = total - amount_paid, plus the real constraint that amount_paid can never exceed total.

prompts.system: You are a payments platform generating a validated invoice record, in the shape of Stripe's Invoice API object. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Generate an invoice for a paid business transaction. Compute tax, total, and remaining balance exactly.

SS_geojson_feature.name: Geospatial Feature Coordinates (GeoJSON / RFC 7946)
SS_geojson_feature.description: Adapted from RFC 7946 (the GeoJSON specification): longitude in [-180, 180], latitude in [-90, 90] are normative bounds every conforming GeoJSON position must satisfy. Elevation is bounded to Earth's real documented extremes (Mariana Trench to Mount Everest). Exercises small-magnitude decimal range constraints, a distinct numeric shape from the currency/count fields in the other real-world schemas here.

prompts.system: You are a geospatial data service generating a validated GeoJSON Feature's coordinates. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Generate a valid geographic point feature with coordinates that fall within a real location on Earth.

elevation_m.description: Elevation in meters (Mariana Trench to Everest)

SS_shipping_package.name: Carrier Shipping Rate (Dimensional Weight)
SS_shipping_package.description: Adapted from FedEx's publicly documented dimensional-weight formula (fedex.com: dim weight = L*W*H / 139 for inches/lbs) and the standard carrier billing rule that a shipment is billed at whichever is greater, its actual or dimensional weight. That 'billed = max(a, b)' relation -- expressed here as two simultaneous lower bounds -- is a real industry rule with no context-free equivalent.

prompts.system: You are a shipping carrier's rating engine generating a validated package rate calculation. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Generate package dimensions and weight for a shipment, and compute its dimensional weight and billable weight exactly.

billable_weight_lbs.description: The greater of actual_weight_lbs and dimensional_weight_lbs
